_comment_models: Runner-specific spellings of the registry bindings (registry/models.yaml is the authority for WHICH model each role gets; this maps profile -> this runner's model name). Single-vendor harness: P5 vendor pins fall back to lineage split (fable reviews sonnet).
_comment_headless: v1 orchestrator dispatch (docs/ORCHESTRATOR.md §5). {prompt} is the rendered dispatch prompt; the command runs with cwd at the repo root with the run branch checked out. No model flag: the rendered subagent's frontmatter pins the model, so naming the subagent in the prompt binds the role AND the model. permission_mode is what makes headless runs unattended; operators may narrow it via project settings allowlists (adapter rule: narrow, never widen).
